name: @pipeworx/mcp-valorant

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: VALORANT reference data (valorant-api.com) — list playable agents with their roles and abilities. Static game data, keyless. Optionally filter by role.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: VALORANT reference data (valorant-api.com) — full details for one agent by uuid: description, role, role description, and all abilities. Static game data, keyless.

tools.name: list_weapons
tools.description: VALORANT reference data (valorant-api.com) — list weapons with category, cost, fire-rate, and magazine size. Static game data, keyless.

tools.name: list_maps
tools.description: VALORANT reference data (valorant-api.com) — list maps with tactical description and icon. Static game data, keyless.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-valorant forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the valorant pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
